parameters.description_zh: 管理告警规则请求体聚合（CREATE/UPDATE/PATCH/BATCH_DELETE/BATCH_ENABLE/BATCH_DISABLE/DELETE/ENABLE/DISABLE 共用，按 action 选填字段）。最小合法示例：CREATE={action:CREATE, workspace, displayName, enabled, datasourceConfig, queryConfig, conditionConfig, scheduleConfig, notifyConfig}；UPDATE={action:UPDATE, uuid, workspace, displayName, enabled, datasourceConfig, queryConfig, conditionConfig, scheduleConfig, notifyConfig}（全量替换语义，未传字段以后端默认值覆盖）；PATCH={action:PATCH, uuid, workspace, 加任意一个待改字段}（部分更新，仅传要改的字段）；DELETE/ENABLE/DISABLE={action, uuid, workspace}；BATCH_DELETE/BATCH_ENABLE/BATCH_DISABLE={action, workspace, uuidList}。CREATE/UPDATE 的三段 config 请严格使用 DatasourceConfigUnified/QueryConfigUnified/ConditionConfigUnified 中 type 字段列出的合法枚举，一个云监控指标类规则最小三元组为 datasourceConfig.type=CLOUD_MONITORING、queryConfig.type=CLOUD_MONITORING_QUERY、conditionConfig.type=CLOUD_MONITORING_CONDITION；一个 Prometheus 规则最小三元组为 PROMETHEUS + PROMETHEUS_SINGLE_QUERY + PROMETHEUS_SIMPLE_CONDITION。禁止使用 CMS_BASIC_DS/CMS_BASIC_QUERY/SLS_CONDITION 等非枚举值
